name: Githyanki Ghustil

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Cloth Armor (Basic Clothing)
items.description:
Jackets, mantles, woven robes, and padded vests don’t, by themselves, provide any significant protection. However, you can imbue them with protective magic. Cloth armor doesn’t slow you down or hinder your movement at all. All characters have proficiency with cloth armor.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Cloth armor grants +1 AC at levels 16-25, and +2 AC at levels 26-30.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Necrotic Smite
powers.requirements: usable only while affected by cloak of shadows

hit.description: damage plus 1d8 necrotic damage plus 1d8 radiant damage

powers.name: Capture Divinity
powers.trigger: when an enemy within 10 squares of the githyanki ghustil uses a divine power

effect.description: The githyanki ghustil regains 27 hit points.
The githyanki ghustil gains total concealment against all enemies until the end of its next turn.
One githyanki ally within 10 squares of the githyanki ghustil gains 15 temporary hit points.
The githyanki ghustil or an ally within 10 squares of it can fly 5 squares.
